metricName.description: The name of the metric this code analysis result is associated with.

metricCode.description: The kebab-case code of the metric this code analysis result is associated with.

itemName.description: The name of the item being analyzed, which could be a file or a package name.

kind.description:
The kind of code analysis result.
Can be either file level result, or package level result.

testKind.description: The test kind this code analysis result is associated with, if the metric is related to a test.

internalErrorMessage.description:
Stores any internal errors that might have been raised during metric evaluation.

If non-empty, it is inferred that code analysis failed for this {@link #metricCode}-{@link #itemName} pair
with the error message stored here.

stats.description: The aggregated statistic values for this metric result.

codeAnalysisMetricMessages.description: The {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Message}s associated with this code analysis result.

compressedMetricMessages.description:
A compressed representation of {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Message}s. Only populated for
{@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Result#packageMetricResults}. The array of #codeAnalysisMetricMessages
across all {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Result#fileMetricResults} for a package are transformed to
be dictionary where the key is the filePkgPathUrl and value is the list of objects that store the line, column
and additional info json.

suppressedCodeAnalysisMetricMessages.description: The {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.SuppressedMessage}s associated with this code analysis result.

compressedSuppressedMetricMessages.description:
A compressed representation of {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.SuppressedMessage}s. Only populated for
{@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Result#packageMetricResults}. The array of {@link #suppressedCodeAnalysisMetricMessages}
across all {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Result#fileMetricResults} for a package are transformed to
be dictionary where the key is the filePkgPathUrl and value is the list of objects that store the line, column
and additional info json.

baseBranchStats.description: The metric stats as computed in the base branch.

deltaStats.description: The delta between the metric stats in the base branch and current branch.

processedMetricMessages.description:
The {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Message.Processed}s associated with this code analysis result.
Only includes the subset of {@link #codeAnalysisMetricMessages} that are applicable to the
changes made in the build for which code analysis was run.

title:
The processed code analysis results to extract the impact of changes made in the build for which
code analysis was run.
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Result.Processed
